_README: Phase-2a circuit intake (the human-in-the-loop step between training and analysis). Add one object to "requests" per sub-circuit you want isolated for a model, then author each entry as a Circuit subclass in models/circuits.py (conditions from models/conditions.py) and run phase 2b (--stages data) to generate each circuit's per-circuit dataset file inputs.json (re-deploy the Modal image first if you run with --modal). There is no 'whole' circuit -- declare only the sub-circuits you want isolated. Full field guide + tips + worked examples: docs/reference/declaring_circuits.md.

_methods.digits: (a) restrict/exclude RAW digits -- detail e.g. "exclude digit 3" or "digits in {0,1}" -> domain_sampler([...]).
_methods.condition: (b) keep inputs satisfying a condition -- raw-digit condition (e.g. "every value <= 4") -> domain_sampler; running/accumulated-state condition (e.g. "total digit-sum <= 12") -> a constructive custom sampler, NOT rejection.
_methods.output_positions: (c) score only some OUTPUT positions -- detail e.g. "indices 0,2,4,6,8" -> answer_index_subset, full input domain.
_methods.custom: (d) a precise custom (batch, seed) -> LongTensor[batch, n] input sampler, described exactly in 'detail'.

_request_schema.slug: short_lowercase circuit folder name, e.g. reverse_only (required; becomes a folder under circuits_data/<model>/ and figures/<model>/)
_request_schema.isolate: plain-English description of the behaviour this circuit isolates (required)

isolate_by.method: one of _methods keys: digits | condition | output_positions | custom (required)

_request_schema.faithfulness_target: optional float in (0,1], informational only (no code reads it): the smallest stage's floor is run_model_pipeline.py --smallest-target, default 0.85 (absolute whole-sequence accuracy floor; winner maximizes (1-n/N)*(1-e/E))

requests.isolate: the plain whole-sequence reverse: with no copies of the boundary digit 3 present, the whole input is a single segment, so the model just reverses
the running-sum accumulation (prefix-sum mod 10) with the threshold-13 reset never triggered, so the reset machinery is unexercised and ablatable

isolate_by.detail: total digit-sum <= 12 (running-state condition -> constructive bounded_sum_sampler(12), not rejection)

requests.isolate: the bare record-detect-and-increment core: with digits in {0,1} the counter can only ever step 1->2 at the first 1 following a leading 0-run (or stay all-1s when x[0]=1), so the task collapses to an x[0]-gate AND a prefix-OR over 'has a 1 appeared yet' selecting output 1 vs 2; this isolates first-strict-improvement detection plus a single increment, with general running-max tracking, the multi-record ladder, and the mod-10 wrap all unexercised/ablatable

With at most one 3 in the input, the running-count-of-3 (mod 10) collapses to detect-the-single-3 + prefix-OR (0->1): output is 0 until the lone 3 appears, then 1 for every position onward (all-0 when no 3). This isolates single-occurrence detection plus a single increment; the multi-step counter ladder and the mod-10 wrap are unexercised/ablatable.

isolate_by.detail: at most 1 occurrence of digit 3 (global occurrence-count condition -> constructive bounded_count_sampler(digit=3, max_count=1), NOT rejection)

requests.isolate: the modular accumulator: with all digits odd-valued ({1,3,5,7,9}) every digit contributes, so the odd-parity detector is always-on (unexercised) and the task collapses to a plain prefix-sum (mod 10) of all digits. Isolates the running-sum accumulator plus the mod-10 wrap.

exactly one odd-valued digit in the input: the nine even digits pass through unchanged and the single odd digit is doubled (mod 10), so the whole output is even-valued. Isolates 'localize the lone odd digit + double it' -- the parity-classify gate fires (selects the doubling branch) at exactly one position while every other position takes the identity/passthrough branch. The simultaneous-multi-doubling and the parity contrast over a mixed sequence are unexercised.

isolate_by.detail: exactly 1 odd-valued digit (global parity-count condition -> constructive one_odd_sampler: pick one position for a uniform odd digit {1,3,5,7,9}, fill the rest with uniform even digits {0,2,4,6,8}; NOT rejection)

requests.isolate: all digits odd-valued ({1,3,5,7,9}): every digit is doubled, so the parity-classify detector is always-on (always selects the doubling branch) and unexercised/ablatable, and DoubleOdd collapses to a pure position-wise (2*x) mod 10 map (= MapMul(2)). Isolates the doubling arithmetic alone, with the parity gate and the identity/passthrough branch unexercised.
running-product locate-and-broadcast a single non-1 factor
parity detector via a single odd digit
running-max record detector on the binary alphabet
novelty/seen-before detector via a single repeat
value==index detector via a single fixed point
single-reset distance ramp

isolate_by.detail: at most one copy of digit 3 (bounded_count_sampler)

requests.isolate: plain running maximum (reset disabled)
decreasing counter (up-branch disabled)
cum-OR set-detector (reset disabled)
sample-and-hold register via a single qualifier
decreasing accumulator (floor unexercised)
Caesar shift via a pinned anchor

partial-prefix sort via a pinned length
